svg.title: errum
svg.desc: Hexagonal logo for the R package errum. A solid punch card with its top-left corner cut fills the middle of the hex, and its top edge steps down in four treads, like a staircase, with the word errum cut out of the band beneath a thin line at probability zero. The treads stand at one item's chance of success: about .85 for an examinee who has every attribute it needs, then .70, .39 and .25 as one, two and three go missing. Under the top tread pi star is cut out; under each lower tread, the penalty it drops to, r star 1, r star 2 or r star 3, with the punched hole beside it that switches that penalty on. Two holes are clean. The first, beside r star 1, is cut but its orange chad still hangs by one corner, because errum is not yet sure that the item needs that attribute.
